traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

multiattack_text: The lizardfolk makes two melee attacks, each one with a different weapon.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

attacks.name: Heavy Club
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

attacks.name: Javelin
attacks.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

attacks.name: Spiked Shield
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
